semantic_identity: Tall warm walnut and clear-glass display cabinet
intended_function: Hold three RoomDefinition-owned collectibles on separate interior shelves without incorporating them into the mesh.

citizen_scale.ratio_or_view: 76-inch cabinet is 152 half-inch citizen-heights; use a dimension-derived schematic if the generated scale cue is inaccurate.

silhouette_requirements: Narrow tall rectangular case with visible side depth.
Finished restrained crown and solid plinth.

construction_materials.construction: Straight framed case with joined side panels and restrained crown/plinth.
construction_materials.material: Warm dark walnut with subtle grain.

construction_materials.construction: Two framed, hinged clear-glass doors with central meeting stile.
construction_materials.material: Clear lightly tinted household glass and walnut.

construction_materials.construction: Three fixed, evenly spaced shelves with visible thickness and supported ends.
Three hinge positions per door and paired small central knobs.

art_direction: Human Room: restrained, believable domestic cabinetry with readable natural wood and glass.
gameplay_distance_readability: At 64–330 inch views, the narrow tall case and paired glazed doors should remain legible.
source_photo_constraints: rooms/room_photo_luna.json instantiates a display cabinet. Sample (2) has only a partial timber object at the far-right edge; it does not prove the full cabinet front, glazing, shelves, or joinery. Treat those as ArtBrief/current-asset evidence, not source-photo evidence.

visual_references.provenance: Object at the far-right edge is cropped and ambiguous; use only broad room wood context.
Godot Art Factory render of accepted display_cabinet-v002.

prohibited_failure_modes: No collectibles, boxes or lights fused into the case.
No opaque door panels or missing side walls.
No ornate carving unsupported by the brief.
No changes to the 33 x 76 x 18 inch envelope or RoomDefinition-owned collectibles.
roomdefinition_authority: ArtBrief dimensions are 33 x 76 x 18 inches. rooms/room_photo_luna.json owns placement, obstacle state, navigation and collectible instances; the mesh only guides appearance.
separate_room_assets: RoomDefinition collectibles and any contents placed on or around the cabinet
